column1: # Corrections of LexiqueMixte.tsv rows (spec docs/specs/lexicon-decisions.md section 6), written by
# `python -m util.build_mixte_corrections` from the accepted mixte_rule / mixte_typo decisions. Do not edit by hand.
# ortho, lemme, cgram, infover, genre, nombre: the key of the OUTPUT row (infover as written, trailing ';' included;
#   genre and nombre tell the NOM/ADJ slots of one spelling apart); it must match
#   exactly one row of the build, else the build fails | phon, syll_cv, orthosyll_cv: the corrected fields
# group_id: the decision that produced the row. Sorted by key.
